name: SPCESM2 subgrid and large-scale simulation dataset
size_as_stated: 55,572,480 samples each for training (2013), validation (2014), and testing (2015); full raw and preprocessed data 'of the order of several TBs'
resolution: CAM6: 2.5° × 1.875°, 26 vertical levels, dt=1800s; SP: 32 columns at 4 km, dt=20s
access: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10598576; full data archived on DKRZ and available upon request

scales.note: SPCESM2 historical run spanning 2003-2015 with 4 km CRM embedded in 2.5 x 1.875 degree CAM6; output sampled at 1800 s time steps.
